pageTitle: 5 Reasons People Choose MLI | Mentor Language Institute
pageDescription: We have helped more than 17,000 students improve their English skills since our opening.

section2.title: 5 Characteristics of Mentor Language Institute
description: We have helped more than 17,000 students improve their English skills since our opening. Why do students choose MLI even though there are so many English schools in Los Angeles? We took a survey of MLI students and their answers are below.
section2.notes: Survey period : January to June in 2017 of 342 students

section3.title: No.1 : Reasonable Price
section3.subtitle: Great Price! From $209 per week Afternoon classes are 40% off the price of morning classes!
description: The number 1 reason students choose MLI is affordability.

The longer you attend our school, the cheaper the tuition. If you apply for 1 month (4 weeks), the tuition is $1,220 = $305 per week. This is already reasonable price in LA. But, if you apply for 48 weeks, the tuition is $10,032 = $209 per week. Please compare our rates with other schools.

section3.title: No.2 : Great Location
section3.subtitle: Westwood & Hollywood : popular areas in Los Angeles
description: We are located in great, popular areas of Los Angeles, Westwood and Hollywood. Students can easily access famous places such as Santa Monica and downtown LA.

section3.title: No.3 : Variety of College Preparation Courses
section3.subtitle: Many students transfer to UCLA and Santa Monica College after studying at MLI.
description: We offer popular test preparation program such as TOEFL®, IELTS™. Many students transfer to UCLA, USC and Santa Monica College after completing our test preparation program.

section3.title: No.4 : Flexible Class Schedule
section3.subtitle: We offer morning, afternoon and evening classes.
description: MLI offers 3 different class schedules. Students can choose from morning, afternoon and evening classes.
section3.notes: ※This is a class schedule for Westwood Campus. If you'd like the Hollywood Campus schedule, please contact us.

section3.title: No.5 : Dormitory
section3.subtitle: Our Partner: US Support Services Inc. offers the opportunity to communicate with students from all over the world at our dormitory.
description: Our partner: U.S. Support Service Inc. arranges homestay programs and also dormitories. They provide more than 40 rooms at our dormitories located near each campus.  Many students stay at a dormitory if it's their first time in the States.
